title: Account mein anjaan paisa aaya? Wapas mat bhejna
hooks: Account mein anjaan ₹50,000 aaya? Ruko, wapas mat bhejna.
Kisi ne galat paisa bheja? Wapas bhejne se pehle ye dekh lo.
Bank se anjaan credit aaya? Ye naya scam hai, bach ke raho.
hook_why: Opens with specific amount + immediate stop command; mirrors top finance shorts that lead with concrete threat and action in first 3 seconds.
metaphor: Money mule trap: unexpected credit is bait; returning it makes you a layer in the laundering chain.

caption:
Account mein anjaan ₹50,000 aaya? Ruko, wapas mat bhejna — ye naya scam hai.

Scammer khud paisa daalta hai, phir QR se wapas mangta hai.

Tum wapas bhejte ho → wo paisa kisi victim ka → tum money mule ban gaye.

Police trace tumhare door pe, scammer saaf bach nikalta hai.

RBI bolta hai: anjaan credit ko haath mat lagao.
Bank ko bolo, cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo turant.
Bank trail freeze karega, scammer pakda jayega, tum safe.

Save karo, kaam aayega 📌
Tere saath bhi hua kya? Comment mein batao.

Education only, not financial advice.

claims.claim: Scammers deposit money then ask victim to return via QR/UPI
claims.basis: Legal Warning India article on Online Refund Scam 2026; documented scam pattern

claims.claim: Returning the money makes you a money mule layer in laundering chain
claims.basis: Cybercrime investigation pattern: police trace transaction to return sender; scammer remains hidden

claims.claim: RBI guideline: do not return unknown credits, inform bank
claims.basis: RBI circulars on customer protection and unauthorized transactions; standard banking ombudsman advice

claims.claim: Report to bank immediately and cybercrime.gov.in for account freezing and recovery
claims.basis: Aseem Juneja guide: bank complaint within 24-48 hours + cybercrime portal for account freezing and recovery
